title: Object types and interfaces

outcomes.can: Trace an object copy and identify a missing required field.

intro: An object groups named fields. A type alias gives a shape a reusable name. An interface can also describe the required fields. The checker accepts a value when its fields fit. At runtime task.title reads the actual title. The expression { ...task, title: next } copies the fields and writes a replacement title on the copy.

steps.text: The spread copies the original fields before the new title is written. Renaming the copy leaves the original title available. For the simple primitive fields here a shallow copy is enough. When a required field is missing the checker reports the mismatch before running the code.
